tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies WebSocket connectivity to backend.

tools.name: -subscribe
tools.description: Subscribe this conversation to one of this app's events (task_created, task_moved, task_assigned, task_unassigned, task_started, task_completed, task_blocked, task_cancelled, task_updated, task_priority_changed, task_progress_note, task_archived, task_unarchived, task_dependency_added, task_dependency_removed, task_linked). Matching events are delivered here as they happen and wake the agent (self-wake guard: an agent is never woken by an event it caused itself). The subscription lives in the backend — it survives restarts of this app. Subscribing again to the same event REPLACES the previous filter. Returns: { subscription: { subscriptionId, topic, event, channelId, mode, filter, wakeUpOn, createdAt }, message }.

event.description: Local event name (the app namespace is implicit). Valid: task_created — A task was created on a board.; task_moved — A task changed column.; task_assigned — A task was assigned to an agent.; task_unassigned — A task lost its assignee.; task_started — An agent started working on a task.; task_completed — A task was completed.; task_blocked — A task was marked as blocked.; task_cancelled — A task was cancelled.; task_updated — A task field changed (title, description, instructions, tags, priority…).; task_priority_changed — A task priority changed.; task_progress_note — A progress note was added to a task.; task_archived — A task was archived.; task_unarchived — A task was restored from the archive.; task_dependency_added — A dependency was added between two tasks.; task_dependency_removed — A dependency was removed.; task_linked — A conversation was linked to a task (its context now lives in that channel).

filter.description: Optional filter. Fields AND-ed, values within a field OR-ed. Only the fields declared for the event are valid — see the event list.

wakeUpOn.description: Event names that wake the agent (response turn). Default: the subscribed event always wakes. Rarely needed with a single-event subscription.

channelId.description: Conversation that receives the events. Defaults to the calling conversation — omit it.

mode.description: notify = silent delivery, wake = trigger an agent response turn. Default: wake.

tools.name: -unsubscribe
tools.description: Cancel this conversation's subscription(s) to this app's events. By subscriptionId, by event name, or — with neither — ALL of this conversation's subscriptions to this app. Idempotent. Returns: { unsubscribed, deleted?, channelId }.

event.description: Cancel the subscription to this event.

tools.name: -list-subscriptions
tools.description: List this conversation's subscriptions to this app's events, plus the app's event catalog (events, payload fields and valid filter fields) to subscribe to. Returns: { subscriptions: [...], events: [...] }.

tools.name: get-project
tools.description: Get project detail + its board columns. Returns: { project: { projectId, name, description, context, status, boardId, createdAt }, board: { boardId, columns: [{ columnId, slug, name, position }] } }. Use list-tasks to enumerate tasks.

tools.name: list-projects
tools.description: List projects in a workspace. Returns: { workspaceId, projects: [{ projectId, name, description, status, boardId, taskCount, activeAgentCount, createdAt }], nextCursor? }. Paginated: default 50, max 200. Use get-project for full detail + board columns.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID (optional, defaults to execution workspace)

tools.name: get-task
tools.description: Get task detail + sub-tasks. Returns: { task: { taskId, title, description, columnName, columnSlug, priority, tags, assigneeName, running, stopRequested, dependencies, progressNotes, projectName, parentTaskTitle?, workflowInputData?, workflowOutputData?, workflowExecutionId?, workflowNodeId?, workflowInputGate?, workflowOutputGate? }, subTasks: [...], agents }. Workflow extension fields are present only when the task was created by the workflow engine.

fields.description: Custom subset of fields for task + subTasks

tools.name: list-tasks
tools.description: List tasks in a project. Returns: { projectId, projectName, tasks: [{ taskId, title, columnName, columnSlug, priority, archived, tags, running, assigneeName, assigneeAvatarUrl }], agents, nextCursor? }. Paginated: default 50, max 200. For agent-view of own tasks use get-my-tasks (runner MCA).

tags.description: Return only tasks that have ALL these tags (optional)

fields.description: Custom subset of fields to return (overrides default whitelist)

tools.name: list-board-agents
tools.description: List agents in the workspace with access to board-manager or board-runner apps. Returns: { agents: [{ agentId, name, fullName, role, avatarUrl, capabilities }], nextCursor? }. Paginated: default 50, max 200.

tools.name: create-project
tools.description: Create a project with an associated Kanban board in a workspace. Returns: { project: { projectId, workspaceId, name, status, boardId }, board: { boardId, columns: [...] } }. Default columns: Backlog, To Do, In Progress, Blocked, Review, Done.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID (optional, defaults to execution workspace)

tools.name: create-task
tools.description: Create a task on a project board. Defaults to Backlog column. Returns: { task: { taskId, title, columnId, priority, tags, assignedAgentId } }. Use batch-create-tasks to create many atomically. `instructions` is required — it gives the assigned agent the context and steps needed to work autonomously.

description.description: Short one-line summary of what the task is about (max ~1000 chars)

instructions.description: Detailed task instructions in markdown — context, specific steps, acceptance criteria, relevant paths, examples, and constraints. This is what the assigned agent receives as their briefing, so providing clear instructions is highly valuable for autonomous execution.

tools.name: batch-create-tasks
tools.description: Create multiple tasks atomically (all succeed or all fail). Max 100 per call. Returns: { projectId, tasks: [{ taskId, title, columnId, priority, tags }], count }. Use create-task for a single task. `instructions` is required for each task — it gives the assigned agent the context and steps needed to work autonomously.

description.description: Short one-line summary of what the task is about (max ~1000 chars)

instructions.description: Detailed task instructions in markdown — context, specific steps, acceptance criteria, relevant paths, examples, and constraints. This is what the assigned agent receives as their briefing, so providing clear instructions is highly valuable for autonomous execution.

tools.name: update-task
tools.description: Partial update of task properties. Omitted fields unchanged. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS } }. To move a task between columns use move-task. To assign an agent use assign-task.

description.description: New short one-line summary of what the task is about (max ~1000 chars)

instructions.description: New detailed task instructions in markdown — context, specific steps, acceptance criteria, relevant paths, examples, and constraints. This is what the assigned agent receives as their briefing, so providing clear instructions is highly valuable for autonomous execution.

tools.name: archive-task
tools.description: Archive or restore a task (manager action). archived=true takes the task out of the active board (done / cancelled / discarded); archived=false restores it and triggers autoplay rescheduling. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS } }.

archived.description: true = archive, false = restore to active board

archiveNote.description: Optional note explaining why the task was archived

tools.name: archive-project
tools.description: Archive a project (soft-delete) and all its non-archived tasks. Only admin/owner can archive. Idempotent — if already archived, returns the project. Returns: { project: { ...PROJECT_FIELDS } }.

archiveNote.description: Optional note explaining why the project was archived

tools.name: update-project
tools.description: Partial update of project properties (name, description, context). context is injected into agent system prompts when working on this project (markdown supported). Returns: { project: { ...PROJECT_FIELDS } }.

context.description: Project context injected into agent system prompts (architecture notes, coding standards, etc.). Markdown supported.

tools.name: update-board-config
tools.description: Update the board execution config for a project. The config object is passed as-is to the board. Currently reserved for future auto-dispatcher settings. Returns: { projectId, config }.

config.description: Board config object (passed as-is to the board document)

tools.name: move-task
tools.description: Move a task to a different column on the board. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS } } (includes columnName + columnSlug after move). Use list-board-subscriptions + subscribe-to-board to get notified when tasks move.

position.description: Position within the column (optional, defaults to end)

reviewAction.description: Set true ONLY when this move is the terminal action of a review (verdict) while reacting to a task_moved→Review event. Enables the single-flight claim so concurrent sessions of yours move the task at most once. Leave unset for normal task management moves.

tools.name: assign-task
tools.description: Assign or unassign an agent to a task. Pass agentId to assign, omit or null to unassign. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS } }.

agentId.description: Agent ID (omit or null to unassign)

tools.name: start-task
tools.description: Start a task: moves to in_progress, creates a headless conversation with the assigned agent, sends the task description as the first message, and links the conversation to the task. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS, channelId }, channelId }. Optional override of agent or prompt.

agentId.description: Optional agent override. Reassigns the task before starting.

prompt.description: Optional custom prompt. Overrides the default task description as the first message.

tools.name: link-conversation
tools.description: Link an existing conversation (channel) to a task. Replaces any previously linked channel. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS, channelId } }. Use start-task to link a new headless conversation instead.

tools.name: add-progress-note
tools.description: Post a progress note on a task (manager action). Notes are visible on the task detail and the board. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_WITH_PROGRESS_FIELDS } }. Runner agents should use the board-runner add-progress-note instead.

reviewAction.description: Set true ONLY when this note is a review verdict posted while reacting to a task_moved→Review event. Enables the single-flight claim so concurrent sessions of yours post at most one review note. Leave unset for normal progress reporting.

tools.name: delete-task
tools.description: Permanently delete a task. Sub-tasks become top-level tasks. Linked conversations are NOT deleted. Irreversible. Returns: { taskId, deleted: true }.

tools.name: delete-project
tools.description: Permanently delete a project and all its tasks and board. Only workspace admin/owner can delete. Irreversible — prefer archive-project for soft-delete. Returns: { projectId, deleted: true }.

tools.name: add-task-dependency
tools.description: Add a dependency: after this call, taskId depends on dependsOnTaskId (dependsOnTaskId must complete first). Cycle detection runs automatically; if adding the edge would create a cycle, the call errors and affected tasks are marked circular_dependency. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS, dependencies } }.

taskId.description: Task that gains the new dependency (the dependent task)

dependsOnTaskId.description: Task that taskId will depend on (must complete first)

tools.name: remove-task-dependency
tools.description: Remove a dependency between two tasks. Idempotent — if the dependency does not exist, the task is returned unchanged. Returns: { task: { ...TASK_FIELDS, dependencies } }.

taskId.description: Task that currently has the dependency

dependsOnTaskId.description: Task to remove from taskId's dependencies

tools.name: get-task-dependencies
tools.description: Get dependencies of a task (tasks that must complete before it can start). Returns: { taskId, dependencies: [{ taskId, title, columnSlug, priority, archived }], count, nextCursor? }. Paginated when large: default 50, max 200.

taskId.description: Task ID whose dependencies to list

tools.name: set-agent-slots
tools.description: Configure parallel execution slots for an agent in a project. slots=0 disables autoplay (also auto-disables playEnabled if it was on). slots≥1 enables the play button. Returns: { relationship: { agentId, projectId, slots, playEnabled, activeSlots } }. Use set-agent-play to toggle autoplay after setting slots.

tools.name: set-agent-play
tools.description: Toggle autoplay for an agent on a project. When enabled=true the agent auto-picks eligible To Do tasks up to its slot limit. Requires slots≥1 (use set-agent-slots first). Disabling does NOT cancel tasks already running. Returns: { relationship: { agentId, projectId, slots, playEnabled } }.

tools.name: subscribe-to-board
tools.description: DEPRECATED (v1.4.4): use the reserved tool `board_manager__subscribe` instead — one event per subscription with declarative filters (e.g. event "task_moved", filter { projectId, taskId, toColumn }); the subscription lives in the backend and survives respawns. This tool still works (kept for existing conversations) but will be removed. Subscribe the current conversation to real-time board events. Events (task moves, archives, assignments, progress notes, dependency changes, autoplay toggles) are delivered to the conversation as they happen. Use filter to narrow events. Returns: { subscription: { subscriptionId, boardId, filter, createdAt } }. Use unsubscribe-from-board to stop.

filter.description: Optional filter to narrow delivered events

agentIds.description: Only events for tasks assigned to these agents

columnIds.description: Only events for tasks in these columns

eventTypes.description: Valid: board.task_moved, board.task_archived, board.task_assigned, board.task_created, board.task_updated, board.task_progress_note, board.agent_play_changed, board.agent_slots_changed, board.dependency_added, board.dependency_removed

taskIds.description: Only events for these specific tasks (task IDs)

wakeUpOn.description: Event types that wake the agent (trigger a response turn). Default: ALL event types wake the agent (only a wakeUpOn list narrows it). Note: an agent is never woken by an event it caused itself (self-wake guard).

tools.name: unsubscribe-from-board
tools.description: Cancel this conversation's subscription to board events for a specific board. Idempotent — if no subscription exists, returns { boardId, unsubscribed: true } unchanged. Returns: { boardId, unsubscribed: true }.

tools.name: list-board-subscriptions
tools.description: List active board subscriptions for the current conversation. Returns: { subscriptions: [{ subscriptionId, boardId, boardName, filter, createdAt }], nextCursor? }. Paginated: default 50, max 200.

tools.name: get-board-status
tools.description: Operational status of a board: per-agent workload + summary. Returns: { boardId, boardName, agents: [{ agentName, slots, playEnabled, activeSlots, activeTasks: [{ taskId, title, projectName }], tasksInProgress, tasksInReview, tasksBlocked, tasksToDo }], summary: { total, byColumn, blockedTasks } }. activeTasks lists the running tasks for each agent with activeSlots > 0. Use to identify bottlenecks.

tools.name: stop-task
tools.description: Send cooperative stop signal to a running task (task.running=true). The assigned runner agent finishes its current step, then moves the task to Blocked. Cooperative — the signal is processed at the next runner turn. Only managers should call this. Returns: { taskId, stopRequested: true }.

taskId.description: Task ID of a running task

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason delivered to the runner

tools.name: subscribe-to-events
tools.description: DEPRECATED (v1.4.4): use the reserved per-app tools instead — `board_manager__subscribe` for this app's events, `<app>__subscribe` for any other app's (e.g. gmail__subscribe with event "email.received"). The reserved tools take the LOCAL event name, validate filters against the app's declaration and keep state in the backend. This tool still works (raw topic + rules) but will be removed. Subscribe the current conversation to MCA events on a topic. Events matching the topic are delivered to the conversation as they happen. Use rules to narrow events. Returns: { subscription: { id, topic, channelId, rules, mode, createdAt } }. Use unsubscribe-from-events to stop.

channelId.description: Channel ID to receive events in (defaults to current conversation)

rules.description: Optional filter rules to narrow delivered events

mode.description: Delivery mode: notify = silent notification, wake = trigger agent response turn (the agent gets a response turn). Default: wake

tools.name: unsubscribe-from-events
tools.description: Delete a channel event subscription by ID. Returns: { deleted: true }.

tools.name: list-event-subscriptions
tools.description: List active event subscriptions for a channel. Returns: { subscriptions: [{ id, topic, channelId, rules, mode, createdAt, lastActivityAt }], nextCursor? }. Paginated: default 50, max 200.

channelId.description: Channel ID to list subscriptions for (defaults to current conversation)
